target_question: Deep local Galois investigation at p_5 = (sqrt(5)) in K = Q(sqrt(5)), Galois group of the Eisenstein quintic, inertial Weil-Deligne type, Artin conductor exponent 3, and existence of the Breuil-Diamond local lift.

primary_sources.title: Formes modulaires de Hilbert modulo p et valeurs d'extensions entre caracteres galoisiens
primary_sources.status: Local lift conditions at v not|p with N_v = 0: only (iii) prescribed WD type and (v) determinant compatibility on inertia are required. Conditions (i), (ii), (iv) are vacuously satisfied at p_5 away from 17.

conclusions.inertia_action: Dihedral group D_5 = C_5 semidirect C_2 (non-abelian)

conclusions.breuil_diamond_lift: Explicity given by the 17-adic representation rho_{J^-, 17}|_{G_{K_p5}}; also unobstructed and canonical by Maschke lifting since 17 does not divide |D_5| = 10.
